PROJECT(SHELL)

# filebrowser.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/filebrowser-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(filebrowser_shims OBJECT filebrowser.c)
target_link_libraries(filebrowser_shims PRIVATE libshell32 libbrowseui libmsvcrt libkernel32)
target_compile_definitions(filebrowser_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(filebrowser filebrowser-cargo filebrowser.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos
    EXTRA_DEPENDS filebrowser_shims psdk)
